checks.name: solutions

checks.name: affected
checks.rule: An affected entry identifies vendor and product; identifying only one receives partial credit.

checks.name: versions
checks.rule: Affected versions or version bounds are stated; defaultStatus alone receives partial credit.

checks.name: cpe
checks.rule: A CPE is stated in affected data or cpeApplicability.

checks.name: severity
checks.rule: A CVSS v3/v4 vector, SSVC decision, or other vendor severity statement is present; CVSS v2 alone receives partial credit.

checks.name: modern_severity
checks.rule: A CVSS v4 vector or SSVC decision is present.

checks.name: impacts
checks.rule: An impact description or CAPEC identifier is present.

checks.name: references
checks.rule: At least one reference URL is present.

checks.name: reference_tags
checks.rule: At least one reference carries tags.

checks.name: remediation
checks.rule: A patch reference receives full credit; vendor-advisory, mitigation, or release-notes receives partial credit.

checks.name: solutions
checks.rule: At least one solution or workaround is present.
